title: Liquid oxygen made by hand docked at the Crimson War Citadel (Krynn) from oxygen bought there, sold into its bid, the rest stored
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 18:57 UTC (orders ENT-083, block MERCURY: the traders left at the capitals after the once lines take standing work there, docked NPC-facility crafting; rules F8, F23, O1 zero empty burn). 34 traders wait docked at the Crimson War Citadel after Krynn's once lines (fill.py status trader 18:25 UTC: 64 trader waiting). The Citadel's book (table books, 18:43 UTC): oxygen_gas asked at 1 cr, liquid_oxygen bid at 1 cr x 1000 (the station's). liquefy_oxygen by hand: 8 oxygen_gas -> 3 liquid_oxygen a run; a run costs about 8.1 cr and sells for 3 cr while the bid holds: crafting XP for about 5.1 cr a run, no fuel, no jump. requires.docked_at keeps it to a ship already docked there (no trip). No requires.bid: what the bid does not take is stored, so the route stays open when the 1 cr bid is drained; liquid_oxygen is no reserve good (game/reserve.tsv, needs.tsv). standing: XP work, never judged on its pay. Three crafts beside it (argon, neon, oxygen) split the 34 ships over three bids. 2026-11-23 19:07 UTC (Mercury): the third craft stop keeps the ship docked on desk watch for 20 minutes (watch_minutes, 0 fuel): a run of 24 to 36 crafts costs about 74 to 122 cr once the 1 cr bids are drained, so the watch halves the burn of the standing crafts while every ship stays at work (orders ENT-083 block MERCURY, P1 pay for itself); measured in flight (F37) and tuned next turn. 2026-11-23 19:18 UTC (Mercury): docked_at also Ironhearth Station, 2 Crimson jumps away (scripts/map.py route): a trader left docked there after Strategic Readiness Assessment waited with no route (fill.py check 19:15 UTC); it flies over once and stays docked at the Citadel. 2026-11-23 19:24 UTC (Mercury): buy 64 -> 56, craft 8 -> 7 runs: a ship with 4 units aboard bought 61 of 64 and the workshop refused the 8 runs for want of inputs ('craft liquefy_oxygen: no inputs', runs.jsonl 19:10 UTC). 2026-11-23 19:29 UTC (Mercury): the 20-minute watch is out again: route_run.py's desk watch calls save_book and save_board, which no line defines, so every run with watch_minutes crashed at its first poll (NameError, line 947; runs.jsonl 19:10 UTC). The fix (fleet-build copy, test red then green) waits for a clean clone (queue.log). 2026-11-23 19:34 UTC (Mercury): max_ships 12 -> 4: once the 1 cr bid of liquid oxygen is drained a craft costs 8.08 cr (8 gas) and it is the fastest recipe (0.54 a run), so it burned most an hour: 30 runs -4,850 cr from 19:01 to 19:33 UTC (runs.jsonl); its ships go to the nitrogen craft. 2026-11-23 19:57 UTC (Mercury): the first stop stores the whole hold before the buy: ships came with full holds and bought 0 or 5 of 60, the workshop refused the runs and the dispatcher rested them after three short zero-credit runs (runs.jsonl 19:39 to 19:47 UTC).
